intro.fr: Jump King Quest se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Jump King Quest can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Nexile sort Jump King Quest en 2026.
text.en: Nexile releases Jump King Quest in 2026.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Daaxren/jkq-archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Jump King Quest.
text.en: The GitHub repository Daaxren/jkq-archipelago, home of the Jump King Quest APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version v8.0, seule version parue au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version v8.0 is released, the only one as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Jump King Quest figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Jump King Quest is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
